title: Small influences and coordinate influences
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $\varepsilon\in\mathbb R$, and let $f$ be a real-valued function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube. The stable influences of $f$ at noise parameter $1$ are all at most $\varepsilon$ if and only if every coordinate influence of $f$ is at most $\varepsilon$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is real-valued on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
